## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D 60-second time trial game on one track, featuring Bugatti-style cars.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game using Three.js from a CDN, with an original “NEON APEX” theme and a geometric blue hypercar inspired by Bugatti styling.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the playable game in `index.html`, including a single circuit, 60-second timer, lap tracking, boost, keyboard and touch controls, HUD, start/countdown, and end-of-race screen.
- Started a local server and opened the game in Playwright.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/preview.jpg` and `screenshots/racing.jpg`.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Optionally inspect the final game behavior and run a quick browser console check.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/preview.jpg`: Latest inspected start-screen screenshot.
- `screenshots/racing.jpg`: Latest inspected driving screenshot.

## Important Context
- Playwright opened the game at `http://localhost:3002`; browser showed a favicon 404 and WebGL performance warnings, but no reported game runtime error.
- Changes are uncommitted.
